title: Family in Fedoras, Brick House & Automobile - Vintage 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid outdoor family portrait taken outside a brick residence, likely during the cooler months of the late 1940s. Two men in suits, overcoats, and fedoras pose alongside two women and three children, including a toddler held in one man's arms and a boy wearing a sailor collar shirt. In the background, the curved roofline and window of a late 1930s to 1940s automobile are visible against bare winter trees, evoking mid-century postwar domestic life in suburban America.
